notes: Packages are only ever disabled with 'pm disable-user --user 0' and re-enabled with 'pm enable'. Nothing is uninstalled. Packages not installed on a given stick are skipped. 'confidence' marks how well the package's purpose is documented by the community.

junk.title: Preinstalled extras most people never open

features.title: Features you might use (asked one by one)

unconfirmed.title: Poorly documented Amazon services (asked one by one, test after each)

packages.label: Special Offers ad service
packages.description: Serves sponsored banners and offers on the home screen.

packages.label: Advertising ID and personalized ads
packages.description: Builds the ad profile used for targeted ads and recommendations.

packages.label: Recommendation feed
packages.description: Feeds promoted rows and banners on the home screen. Home rows from your installed apps stay.

packages.label: Autoplay previews
packages.description: Plays promoted video previews in the home screen hero banner.

packages.label: Shop on TV
packages.description: In-TV shopping for Amazon products.

packages.label: Shop on TV (Fire TV client)
packages.description: In-TV shopping for Amazon products.

packages.label: Device platform logger
packages.description: Collects diagnostic logs and uploads them to Amazon.

packages.label: Telemetry emitter
packages.description: Sends usage and error reports to Amazon.

packages.label: Wireless metrics
packages.description: Reports Wi-Fi and Bluetooth statistics to Amazon.

packages.label: Performance collection
packages.description: Collects performance data for Amazon.

packages.label: Crash reporter
packages.description: Uploads crash dumps to Amazon.

packages.label: Client metrics
packages.description: Collects app usage metrics for Amazon.

packages.label: Automatic content recognition
packages.description: Analyzes what plays on screen for viewing statistics. Mostly on Fire TV Edition TVs.

packages.label: Wi-Fi password cloud backup
packages.description: Saves your Wi-Fi passwords to your Amazon account.

packages.label: Kindle connect
packages.description: Kindle book integration.

packages.label: Store demo content
packages.description: Retail demo mode content.

packages.label: Tutorial videos
packages.description: First-run tutorial content.

packages.label: GameCircle
packages.description: Old Amazon game achievements service.

packages.label: Amazon Photos
packages.description: Photos app and photo screensaver. Keep it if you use your own photos as the screensaver.

packages.label: Amazon Music
packages.description: Amazon Music app and background sync.

packages.label: Freevee
packages.description: Free ad-supported Amazon streaming app.

packages.label: Amazon miniTV
packages.description: Free short-video streaming app sold in India.

packages.label: Games hub
packages.description: Games section and Luna promotions.

packages.label: Silk browser
packages.description: Amazon web browser.

packages.label: Amazon Kids and parental profiles
packages.description: Kids profiles and time limits. Keep it if children use this TV.

packages.label: Alexa notifications
packages.description: Alexa alerts and notification popups.

packages.label: Smart home dashboard
packages.description: Camera feeds and smart home device map. Keep it if you view Ring or other cameras on the TV.

packages.label: Matter smart home linking
packages.description: Links Matter smart home devices.

packages.label: Sideload scanner
packages.description: Scans for sideloaded apps and blocks ones Amazon flags. Disable it if you sideload apps.

packages.label: Forced update installer
packages.description: Installs Fire OS updates without asking. Disabling it means you install updates yourself.

packages.label: System updates
packages.description: Downloads Fire OS updates, including security fixes. Most people should keep it.

packages.label: Amazon Appstore
packages.description: Installs and updates apps such as Netflix and YouTube. Most people should keep it.

packages.label: Special Offers helper (blackbird)
packages.description: Part of the Special Offers family. Exact role undocumented.

packages.label: Hedwig push service
packages.description: Believed to deliver push notifications. Undocumented.

packages.label: Audio home
packages.description: Believed to handle Echo home theater audio pairing. Keep it if you pair Echo speakers.

packages.label: Easy upgrade
packages.description: Believed to promote device upgrades. Undocumented.

packages.label: Whisperplay contracts
packages.description: Part of the phone-to-TV casting stack. Keep it if you cast from the Prime Video phone app.
